Chapter 650 - 650 Anticipation; Barbecue (2)

Chapter 650 - 650 Anticipation; Barbecue (2)

650 Anticipation; Barbecue (2)

Lin Fan bent down and picked up the bird. “I don’t think I need to worry about food.”

The crew-cut man was stunned on the spot.

He could not help but look up at the sky, as if he wanted to see if he could pick up a bird.

Unfortunately, he did not have such luck.

The sky gradually darkened.

All the students took out their sleeping bags and looked for a suitable place to sleep.

“Do you think there’ll be snakes at night?”

“What if there are suddenly mutated beasts?”

“I don’t think so.”

…

The more they talked, the more worried they became. Their eyes could not help but look around.

Class Monitor Zhang Fen said, “Let’s take turns to go on duty. It’ll be three people in a group. We’ll start at 12 o’clock and be on duty for four hours. Then, we’ll change to another group. What do you think?”

Everyone nodded in agreement.

Being on duty was indeed a lot more reassuring.

“Alright, then it’s settled. To be fair, I’ll use a random name generator.”

Then, he took out the foldable display and randomly picked the names.

Soon, the name list appeared.

The first night (first half): Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang.

The first night (second half): Zhang Fen, Liu Zhihao, Song Li.

The second night (first half):

…

The night gradually deepened.

In today’s world, there were countless forms of entertainment.

12 o’clock was very early.

However, today, many people had already entered their sleeping bags.

Soon, some even started snoring.

Today was too tiring for them.

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang sat in front of the fire, drinking hot tea and coffee. They were quite satisfied.

Everyone was young, and after chatting for a while, they quickly became familiar with each other.

At this moment, Li Dongqiang suddenly saw the big bird beside him and could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, what are you planning to do with it?”

“I want to roast its meat,” Lin Fan said.

“Barbecue meat? Not bad. Unfortunately, we don’t have any seasonings. Otherwise, it would be very good for us to eat barbecued meat while on duty,” Li Dongqiang said.

Xia Xue said, “I don’t know if anyone brought seasonings.”

As she spoke, she looked at the backpacks in front of the sleeping bags.

Obviously, she was looking for seasonings.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “I brought seasonings.”

After a thousand years of accumulation and gains, the volume of Lin Fan’s internal space had already reached over a million cubic meters.

Two days ago, when Lin Fan had nothing to do, he had bought all the items he needed and placed them into his internal dimension.

Lin Fan put his hand into his backpack, looking for some spices.

In fact, he was just using his mind, and all kinds of condiments appeared in his hand from the internal space.

Lin Fan took out bottle after bottle of condiments and placed them on the ground.

“Let me see,” Li Dongqiang said excitedly. “Oil, pepper, chili pepper… Lin Fan, you have a complete set! Good job!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he could not help but give a thumbs-up.

Li Dongqiang continued, “The condiments are complete!” Lin Fan, just you watch. I’ll show you what I can do!”

Then, he quickly plucked the bird’s feathers.

This was a relatively large task.

After all, there were too many feathers.

“It’s a pity that there’s no lake here,” Li Dongqiang said. “Otherwise, it’ll be easy to pluck the feathers if we boil some hot water.”

“Let me do it,” said Lin Fan.

He saw that Xia Xue was looking forward to the roast bird meat.

If he allowed Li Dongqiang to pluck the feathers slowly and then slowly roast it…

He was afraid that Xia Xue would not be able to eat the meat today.

Lin Fan took out a fruit knife and waved it.

Bird feathers fell like snow.

In just ten seconds, the entire bird became bald.

Li Dongqiang gave a thumbs-up again and said, “F*ck! It’s done just like that? That’s so awesome!

“Lin Fan, do you sell chicken?”

Sell chicken?

He asked if the richest man in the world sold chicken?

The greatest existence in a thousand years sold chicken?

If these words were heard by some insiders, who knew what they would think?

Lin Fan smiled, “I don’t sell chicken, but I used to eat this often. After making it a few times, I gained some experience.”

Lin Fan did not say those words carelessly.

A thousand years ago, when he was in the forbidden area, he did eat a lot.

Then, Lin Fan picked up a thicker branch and ran it through the bird’s stomach.

Then, he would occasionally brush oil and sprinkle seasonings…

Not long after, the bird’s appearance began to turn golden. Drops of grease slowly dripped down, emitting an extremely alluring fragrance.

Xia Xue and Li Dongqiang, who were sitting next to the fire, kept their eyes on the big bird. They could not help but swallow.

In fact…

They were not the only ones gulping. The audience who were watching the live broadcast silently in front of the screen also gulped.

Little Painter: [I can smell the fragrance even through the screen.]

Time Like Water: [Such a big bird must taste good!]

Mysterious Man: [So much grease! All of it dripped onto the ground… What a waste!]

Water: [Isn’t this a live broadcast in the forbidden area? Why did it become a late-night supper show?]

Quiker: [I just laid down and suddenly felt hungry after seeing this video. Who can tell me where I can eat the same type of barbecue?]

Fate: [Lin Fan was able to make the general manager of the Imperial Hotel serve him with the greatest care and make the staff of Yuesse Snow Tea personally deliver him drinks. He’s tall and handsome. Now, he even knows how to barbecue! The perfect Prince Charming is definitely Lin Fan!]

My heart: [If my husband is even one-tenth as good as Lin Fan, that would be perfect.]

Nothing Is Difficult in This World: [If my boyfriend is one percent as good as Lin Fan, then I’d be happy.]

…

Lin Fan did not know that he had become the standard.

That was, anyone who was a fraction of Lin Fan was a qualified boyfriend or husband.

…

Lin Fan used a fruit knife to gently cut open the bird’s skin, revealing the tender meat inside.

The alluring fragrance became even stronger.

Lin Fan nodded. “We can eat now.”

Then, he cut a piece of meat and handed it to Xia Xue. “Try it. How does it taste?”

Xia Xue could not bear it anymore and replied, “Alright.”

As soon as she finished speaking, she stuffed the meat into her mouth.

After she ate the meat, Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes instantly lit up. She praised, “Delicious!”

Li Dongqiang did not wait for Lin Fan to speak and said, “Is that so? Then I’ll try it too.”

Then, he picked up the fruit knife and cut a piece of meat.

Li Dongqiang did not care how hot the meat was and hurriedly put it into his mouth.

“It’s so delicious!” Li Dongqiang exclaimed excitedly.

In just a few seconds, the meat in his hand was eaten clean.

Hence, he quickly cut another large piece of meat.

Lin Fan also cut another piece of meat and handed it to Xia Xue. “Don’t worry, there’s still a lot.”

“Delicious!” Li Dongqiang praised again.

Perhaps they were eating too loudly and had woken up their sleeping classmates.

Perhaps the aroma of the roasted meat was too strong and it pulled the sleeping students back from their dreams.

The long-haired beauty sleeping in the middle slowly opened her eyes.

She sniffed hard and muttered, “What’s that smell? It smells so good!”

As she spoke, she slowly sat up and turned to look in the direction of the fragrance.

Soon, the long-haired beauty’s gaze fell on the roasted meat on the fire.

“Barbecued meat?” the long-haired beauty said in surprise.

She could not help but gulp. She got up and walked forward slowly.

The first person had already woken up. Soon, the rest followed.

Not long after, everyone climbed out of their sleeping bags and came to the fire. Their eyes were burning as they looked at the brightly colored roasted meat on the fire. They could not help but swallow their saliva.
